principles: Keep story metadata classification centralized so freshness and dirty gate stay aligned.
Normalize path casing only for Koala metadata prefixes; keep material source detection strict.
Regression tests must cover the user-visible stale-loop path and the safety boundary.
Prefer small targeted changes over new policy machinery.
drivers: Cord Team Mac is blocked from clean DONE by uppercase Docs/story metadata commits.
Koala CLI must not treat real source/package/config changes as metadata-only.
Existing smoke tests already exercise freshness and dirty gate behavior.

options.name: case-normalize central metadata classifier
pros: Fixes evidence freshness and dirty worktree consumers through one shared function
Works for Docs/story and docs/story without duplicating prefixes
cons: Needs regression tests to prove it does not over-exempt unrelated docs paths

options.name: add uppercase prefixes beside lowercase prefixes
pros: Easy to reason about for the immediate Mac path
cons: Duplicates policy entries and misses mixed-case variants

options.name: special-case Mac repo storyDir from config
cons: Freshness currently classifies git paths without always loading external host config
More invasive for a simple metadata prefix bug

rationale: A central lowercase normalization fixes the immediate Docs/story stale loop while preserving one policy source for freshness and dirty gate classification.

preMortem.trigger: The classifier lowercases and matches a prefix that is too broad
preMortem.consequence: Evidence stays fresh after a real material change
preMortem.mitigation: Keep prefixes specific to story metadata and assert docs/requirements remains material in freshness smoke

preMortem.scenario: Dirty gate still blocks uppercase Docs/story files
preMortem.trigger: Only currentMaterialHash is fixed but dirty worktree classifier uses a separate path function
preMortem.consequence: DONE still fails on unexpected_dirty_files after validate writes story evidence
preMortem.mitigation: Reuse the central isStoryMetadataPath and add/adjust dirty classifier smoke for Docs/story

preMortem.scenario: Validation channel fallback still treats uppercase metadata commit as unacceptable
preMortem.trigger: validate-channel has its own story metadata helper
preMortem.consequence: Normal-channel legacy fallback may flag Koala metadata commits even after freshness passes
preMortem.mitigation: Normalize validate-channel metadata helper or delegate to the shared classifier and cover with a small assertion if needed
